visual.general_description: Two-series line chart of AST and ALT in U/L across perioperative time labels, with a legend.
visual.detailed_description: Line chart on a white background with horizontal gridlines. The y-axis title is "[U/L]" with tick labels from 0 to 2000 in steps of 200. The x-axis has category labels written at an angle: "preope", "4h", "24h", "POD2", "POD4", "POD6", "POD8", "POD13", "POD18" and "POD22"; the plotted line points are more numerous than the printed labels, so not every point has a label. A legend at the upper right lists a blue line "AST" and a red line "ALT". Both lines start together at the leftmost point, rise steeply to a single peak, then fall steeply, cross each other during the fall, and then flatten into low lines toward the right that run close together and cross each other again. The blue AST line reaches a higher peak than the red ALT line. No data labels are printed.

visual.general_description: Axial abdominal CT slice with five white arrowheads and a printed "Th10" label.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale axial CT image of the upper abdomen. A row of five white arrowheads runs diagonally across a large homogeneous soft-tissue organ region on the image left, along the edge of a slightly darker area next to the arrowheads. The text label "Th10" is printed in white-outlined letters over the vertebral body. Bright ribs and a vertebra are visible at the periphery and center-bottom, and dark gas-filled regions appear at the image right. Partly cut-off digits are printed at the lower-left edge of the frame. No orientation letters or laterality markers are printed.
